newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Broken water main leaves taps dry in Dar es Salaam.
newsitem.headline: Broken water main leaves taps dry in Dar es Salaam.

text.p: A break in the main pipe carrying water to the Tanzanian commercial capital had thousands of Dar es Salaam residents desperately seeking supplies on Sunday.
Local officials said about three-quarters of the city's three million people relied on water from the Ruvu River. The supply was cut on Saturday when the main pipe burst.

Falling river levels had already cut supplies to the lowest in 40 years and newspapers said at least 13 people had died from cholera. Some embassies were planning to move staff to Arusha, northern Tanzania, where water was still available, one diplomat told Reuters.

The Sunday Observer reported clouds over Tanzania's northern coastal belt. If the build-up continued, the prospects for rain in the coming week were good, it quoted meteorological officials as saying.
